title: Cross-functional Stewardship Playbook for High-Variance Security Asks
creator: Aria Thompson
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines a cross-functional stewardship playbook to triage and resolve high-variance security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO scopes, HIPAA/DPA constraints, GDPR data residency questions, and long vendor questionnaires). The goal is to reduce time-to-resolution on complex customer intake, provide deterministic routing and accountable owners, and create an evidence bundler that reduces back-and-forth with customers by ~40%.

Why now:
- Increasing REVENUE blockage reports from Sales for late-stage deals (avg 12 days to first substantive response)
- Security team overloaded with ad-hoc intake; inconsistent scope decisions and missing remediations
- Customers expect deterministic SLAs and a single steward who can coordinate Product, Security, Legal, and Solutions Engineering

Scope & Out-of-scope:
- In-scope: create a decision ladder, variance scorecard, steward role definition, templates for rapid replies, an automated Evidence Bundler (MVP orchestration), and escalation paths for new or ambiguous asks.
- Out-of-scope: full automation of legal contract edits and building an LLM answerer for questionnaires (future job).

Goals / Success metrics:
- Reduce median triage-to-first-response for high-variance asks from 12d -> 3d
- Reduce total rounds of clarification by 30% for cases requiring cross-team input
- Achieve SLA for "Steward assignment" within 24 hours for 90% of incoming tickets
- Evidence Bundler adoption by Solutions Engineers on >= 60% of enterprise cases in 12 weeks

Stakeholders:
- Product Management: Aria Thompson (creator, escalation owner)
- Security: Priya Rao (principal security engineer)
- Legal/Privacy: Mateo Silva (counsel)
- Solutions/SE: Juniper Kwan (senior solutions engineer)
- Observability & Console: Maria Gomez

Key deliverables:
1) Variance Scorecard (decision ladder + numerical score) - a lightweight rubric to classify asks as LOW/MED/HIGH variance, mapping to routing policy and SLA.
2) Steward role runbook - responsibilities, handoff checklist, and SLAs.
3) Triage templates - pre-filled answers and evidence pointers for common SOC2/ISO questions and DPA clauses.
4) Evidence Bundler (MVP) - service that composes an evidence package (SOC2 attestation link, encryption docs, KMS config, network diagrams) as a downloadable bundle and populates standard questionnaire fields.
5) Escalation & fallback matrix - when to involve Legal, Engineering remediation, or propose compensating controls.
6) Training materials & office hours for SEs and AMs.

Decision trade-offs considered:
- Full automation vs. stewarded approach: chose stewarded + semi-automated bundler for first iteration because many asks require judgment and contract nuance; full automation risks incorrect commitments.
- Granular scoring vs. simple buckets: selected a 7-point numeric score collapsed to 3 buckets to balance fidelity and cognitive load.
- Centralized evidence store vs. per-case attachments: central store wins for reuse but requires upfront curation; we will start with a curated central bucket + per-case supplements.

Acceptance criteria:
- Scorecard doc published in Confluence with example mappings and review signoffs from Security and Legal.
- Steward role template published and integrated into Linear intake flow (auto-assignment rule created).
- Evidence Bundler MVP prototype that generates a ZIP with at least: SOC2 link, standard encryption statement, KMS integration summary, and network diagram PDF.
- Dashboard card in Console showing triage latency and steward assignment SLA.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Misclassification leading to risky approvals. Mitigation: require Legal/Privacy co-sign for any HIGH-variance case before committing.
- Risk: Evidence Bundler contains stale docs. Mitigation: versioned artifacts and a "last-verified" stamp with weekly review cadence.
- Risk: Resource contention for Stewards. Mitigation: rotated pager schedule + escalation to a second-line steward pool.

Implementation plan (high-level):
Week 1 (Feb 10 - Feb 16): Draft variance scorecard, steward runbook, and sample templates. Review with Security + Legal.
Week 2 (Feb 17 - Feb 23): Build Linear routing rules, LB for auto-assign; begin Evidence Bundler tech spike (lambda + S3 prototype).
Week 3 (Feb 24 - Mar 2): Integration tests for bundler; SE office hours and pilot with 3 active deals.
Week 4 (Mar 3 - Mar 9): Iterate on scorecard and templates from pilot feedback; publish Confluence; add dashboard telemetry.
Week 5 (Mar 10 - Mar 20): Roll out steward rotation, train GTM, finalize release notes for console-2025.04.

Links & artifacts:
- Confluence (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Cross-Functional+Stewardship+Playbook
- Evidence Bundler spike doc (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-evidence-bundler-spike
- Pilot notes (shared doc): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-pilot-notes
- GitHub spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evidence-bundler/pull/23
- Demo dashboard mock: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/demo/triage-sla

Open questions:
- Should HIGH-variance automatic escalation create a Legal review JIRA with prefilled context? (Security + Legal prefer yes; needs SE UX work)
- Do we expose "last-verified" timestamps to customers in the Evidence Bundler? (Privacy leaning: yes, improves trust)
- What telemetry threshold triggers an automated re-review of a bundled artifact? (proposed: 30 days or when related control changes)

Next steps / Immediate tasks:
- (Owner: Liam) finalize scorecard and record a 30-minute sync with Legal (by 2025-02-14).
- (Owner: Priya) provide list of canonical evidence artifacts and verification owners (by 2025-02-17).
- (Owner: Juniper) recruit 3 pilot accounts and collect baseline triage metrics (by 2025-02-21).
- (Owner: Maria) create initial dashboard card for steward assignment SLA (by 2025-02-24).

Longer-term opportunities (post-MVP):
- LLM-assisted draft answers with steward-in-the-loop to reduce drafting time.
- Full contract clause library with change-tracking and outcome templates for commonly negotiated exceptions.
- Integration between Evidence Bundler and customer-facing portal so customers can download the same artifact package.
